'''Zotar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. The [[Exarch]] of the [[Old World]], he also participated in gladiatorial combat in the [[Arena Grand]], where he obtained such titles as "The Bringer of Death", The [[High Justice]] of Pain" and "The Emperor of Agony". By [[3630 BBY]] Zotar held the title of the Eternal Champion of the Arena, for which he was challenged by the "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." Zotar faced his challenger in [[After Shock]], a captured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] walker, but was nevertheless defeated in the tenth and last round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zotar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the tenth and final boss of the "Eternal Championship".
